svg.title: Trots Oudtshoorn colourful white T-shirt front
svg.desc: Pop-art front print with crown, sunrise, colourful full brand name and ostrich feather. Intended garment colour: white. Transparent background. All lettering is vector geometry; no fonts or linked images.
